Figure/report/export consumers migrated to explicitReportView keyed by(run,fullReportingSpec,scale). Same-ID report edits invalidate numeric reads; wrong-scale replies are refused even with identical numerical values. NativeReportCell/ReportParticipant refs retained. Participant D uses its declared sigma; participants.csv/methods facts use the first declaredParticipantD panel scale, falling back to first estimation scale only when no participant panel exists. BundleRequest retains this scale, table metadata and README declare it, and export refuses scale-mismatched reports. Paired counts are cited only when a typed contrast was explicitly declared.

Validation: JVM47/47 +Scala.js47/47 figure/app tests;12/12headless figure JavaFX tests; strictFigureExport10/10 +ExportBundle16/16 (golden writing disabled); allcoreJVM/coreJS/desktop Test sources-Werrorcompile. Re-recordedSVG/PDF goldens remove old undeclared paired assertions, and result table digest records nullable matched_trial. No widened tolerance or fabricated scalar fallback. Final full-tree gates/SHA receipt remain pending; this note does not close the summary/S3.7 acceptance on targeted checks alone.
